g0_amendment_proposal.phase_2011_2017_label: 服务延续、组织退出与基础设施转移
g0_amendment_proposal.hypothesis_H_C12_01_v0_2: Eastserve 的社区项目型技术影响在 2010 年后减弱，但其网络基础设施并未消失，而是转入 CityServe/ITS 的商业运营并于 2014 年升级；组织/品牌影响与技术基础设施影响出现分离。
g0_amendment_proposal.note: M22/M23 show the successor CityServe vehicle also entered liquidation in 2011 and dissolved in 2013, while the network was acquired and upgraded by ITS in 2014. This strengthens the distinction between organisational exit and infrastructure continuity.
